li.label: compound eyes
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sees differently. [PAWN_possessive] visual field is wider, [PAWN_possessive] motion tracking faster, [PAWN_possessive] aim noticeably better as a result. [PAWN_pronoun] also spots things [PAWN_pronoun] probably wasn't meant to, which makes [PAWN_objective] occasionally difficult to be around.

li.label: chitinous skin
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has developed a carapace where skin used to be. It works — cuts that would wound others don't get through cleanly, blunt trauma distributes differently. It also looks like exactly what it is, and most people react to it accordingly.

li.label: hive mind
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] functions best as part of something. Coordinated work, shared tasks, collective effort — [PAWN_pronoun] slots into group dynamics better than most people understand their own role. Alone, asked to create or think independently, [PAWN_pronoun] loses something essential.

li.label: metamorphosis
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learns fast and heals quickly — two things that look like separate traits but probably have the same source. [PAWN_pronoun] adapts to new skills with less friction than most, and minor injuries don't linger the way they do for others.

li.label: swarm tactics
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fights with a coordination instinct that seems almost involuntary — reading positions, filling gaps, pressing pressure. [PAWN_pronoun] works alone when necessary but operates differently when others are fighting nearby. Colony isolation makes [PAWN_objective] restless in ways that eventually surface.

li.label: insectoid digestion
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] processes organic matter with a thoroughness that has no equivalent in normal biology. Food poisoning isn't something [PAWN_pronoun] experiences. [PAWN_possessive] body extracts nutrition from things others can't touch. The social cost of eating in front of people is [PAWN_possessive] to manage.

li.label: web weaving
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works with a precision that's almost unsettling to watch — fine, repetitive, deliberate. Textiles, traps, anything that rewards patience and a steady hand. [PAWN_pronoun] has no interest in speed and no patience for work that doesn't reward care.
